To maximize the total reward in a bandit problem, we must balance exploration (trying unknown arms to estimate their means) and exploitation (pulling the arm with the highest observed mean).

Since you have three arms and have only explored one of them ("Highest Reward"), it is statistically optimal to explore the other two arms ("Lowest Reward" and "Intermediate Reward") to determine if either of them offers a higher expected return than the current known mean of 1.3.

I will start by exploring the "Intermediate Reward" arm.
